description: Animated Ocelin with running sessions, subscription percentages and optional RAM.

required.reason: Reads Ocelin's fixed local summary file and opens the fixed ocelin://panel link when clicked, using normal user rights. The host does not sandbox process providers.
Reads Ocelin's opt-in running counts, remaining subscription percentages and optional RAM totals. No session names, project paths, prompts, account identities or credentials.
Refreshes the summary every two seconds while this widget is enabled.
